ast3_share.label: Assisted threes
ast3_share.def: Share of made threes that were assisted

ast_share.label: Assisted share
ast_share.def: Share of made field goals that were assisted

astp.label: AST%
astp.def: Share of made field goals that were assisted (AST / FGM)

blkp.label: BLK%
blkp.def: Blocks per 100 of the opponent's two-point attempts

bonus_share.label: Bonus free throws
bonus_share.def: Share of free-throw attempts from the bonus

c_efg.label: eFG% (competitive)
c_efg.def: eFG% with garbage-time possessions left out

c_ftmr.label: FT made rate (FTM/FGA, competitive)
c_ftmr.def: Free throws made per 100 FGA, garbage time out

c_ftr.label: FT attempt rate (FTA/FGA, competitive)
c_ftr.def: Free-throw attempts per 100 field-goal attempts (FTA / FGA), garbage time out

c_margin.label: Competitive margin
c_margin.def: Points minus points allowed with garbage time out

c_orebp.label: OREB% (competitive)
c_orebp.def: Share of own missed chances won back, garbage time out

c_tovp.label: TOV% (competitive)
c_tovp.def: TOV% with garbage-time possessions left out

chances_pp.label: Chances per possession
chances_pp.def: Chances per possession (an offensive rebound starts a new chance)

dreb_start.label: Possessions from a defensive rebound
dreb_start.def: Share of possessions that began with a defensive rebound

early_share.label: Early-clock share
early_share.def: Share of timed first chances ending within 8 seconds

ftmr.label: FT made rate (FTM/FGA)
ftmr.def: Free throws made per 100 field-goal attempts (Oliver's FTM / FGA)

ftr.label: FT attempt rate (FTA/FGA)
ftr.def: Free-throw attempts per 100 field-goal attempts (FTA / FGA)

garbage_share.label: Garbage-time share
garbage_share.def: Share of possessions played in garbage time

handle100.label: Ball-handling turnovers
handle100.def: Travels, double dribbles and carries per 100 possessions

late_share.label: Late-clock share
late_share.def: Share of timed first chances ending after 16 seconds

live_share.label: Live-ball turnover share
live_share.def: Share of turnovers that were steals

m_h1.label: First-half margin
m_h1.def: Points minus points allowed in the first half

m_h2.label: Second-half margin
m_h2.def: Points minus points allowed in the second half

midp.label: Mid-range FG%
midp.def: Field-goal % on twos away from the rim

midr.label: Mid-range rate
midr.def: Share of field-goal attempts that are twos away from the rim

offto_ppc.label: Points per chance off turnovers
offto_ppc.def: Points per chance after an opponent turnover

p3r.label: 3PA rate
p3r.def: Share of field-goal attempts that are threes

pace3q.label: Pace (first 75%)
pace3q.def: Possessions per 40 minutes over the first 75% of regulation

pace_own.label: Own pace
pace_own.def: The side's own estimated possessions per 40 minutes

paint.label: Paint points
paint.def: Points in the paint per game

ppc_early.label: Points per chance, early
ppc_early.def: Points per first chance ending within 8 seconds

ppc_late.label: Points per chance, late
ppc_late.def: Points per first chance ending after 16 seconds

rimr.label: Rim rate
rimr.def: Share of field-goal attempts at the rim (within 125 cm)

sc_freq.label: Second-chance frequency
sc_freq.def: Share of chances that were second chances

starters_net.label: Starters' plus-minus
starters_net.def: Plus-minus of the starting five together, per game

top5_min_share.label: Top-five minutes share
top5_min_share.def: Share of minutes played by the five most-used players

top_avg.label: Seconds per possession
top_avg.def: Average time of possession, from gaining the ball to its last action

top_share.label: Time of possession share
top_share.def: Share of timed possession seconds that were this side's

tovp.label: TOV%
tovp.def: Turnovers per 100 plays: TOV / (FGA + 0.44 × FTA + TOV)

trips100.label: Free-throw trips
trips100.def: Trips to the line per 100 possessions

usg_hhi.label: Usage concentration
usg_hhi.def: Herfindahl index of usage (100 = one player takes every shot)
